questions.question: What did Gideon refuse when the people wanted to make him ruler?
options: To keep the gold that they offered him
To accept land as a reward for victory
To rule over them, saying the LORD would rule
To take for himself a wife from among their daughters
questions.answer: To rule over them, saying the LORD would rule

questions.question: What did Gideon make from the gold that became a snare to Israel?
Israel had rest (peace) for forty years in the days of Gideon.
Gideon said, "I will not rule over you... the _____ will rule over you."
Gideon made an _____ of gold that became a snare to his household.
